Team —

The board has asked us to confirm the executive headcount slate for Q3 as part of next Thursday's packet. Attached are the current slate (Q3_Exec_HC_Slate.xlsx) and the draft board packet (Board_Packet_Draft_v2.pdf). High level: we are asking for authorization for 4 executive-level hires (2 VP, 2 Senior Dir) tied to growth and ops.

Asks:
- Please confirm comp bands and any redlines on the slate by EOD Friday (5/14).
- Approve the final board packet language (I’ve flagged the board-facing rationale in the draft).
- Confirm funding source for the two ops roles (capitalized vs. opex).

Quick context bullets:
- Role mix: 2 revenue-facing (VP Sales Ops, VP Customer Growth), 2 ops (Sr Dir Reliability, Sr Dir Security).
- Target total comp ranges in Comp_Band_Proposals.csv — Marcus, I left your notes inline.
- If we don’t get sign-off we’ll need to move the slate to the July packet, which delays hiring by ~8–10 weeks.

I’ll consolidate and send the final packet to Board Secretary and Jane Miller (exec search) on Friday evening.

Thanks —
Vivek

Marcus —

Confirmed: the two ops roles (Sr Dir Reliability, Sr Dir Security) will be charged to the 2027 infra initiative capital allocation in Q3 (we have headroom after reclassing the storage refresh). I’ll attach the finance note to the packet.

On comp bands: the +7% for VP Sales Ops is reasonable; approve the signing bonus language for Security but mark it as contingent on background checks and final comp committee approval.

I recommend we include a one-paragraph risk mitigation note in the board packet: if we cannot secure candidates within target comp bands within 10 weeks we will bring a revised ask (paused hiring + carryforward). That will set expectations.
